review.method: Ordered candidate sweep of all polished turns; expanded full-turn context at selected decisions; supplementary numeric-clock/spatial sweep; focused semantic review; deterministic provenance checks.
review.limitation: Not an independent exhaustive semantic audit of every turn. Recall not measured. Source transcription uncertainty retained.

summary: Three occupied day slots and two completed nights; start date supplied by YAML. Split-party errands and mobile ship positions matter.
issues: Morning → pre-dawn is local-clock change on teleport, not negative elapsed time.
Two completed overnights versus “three days” in the countdown: possibly inclusive counting, but an intended three elapsed days would conflict. Preserve both statements.
Final planned 4 a.m. departure is excluded from elapsed chronology.
No route coordinates are reconstructed from gestures at the Roll20 map; vessels have dynamic positions, not a permanent city parent.
